sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，廢衍州為定平縣，廢武州為潘原縣。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on renzi, Yanzhou was abolished and made Dingping County; Wuzhou was abolished and made Panyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on renzi Yanzhou was abolished and made Dingping County, and Wuzhou was abolished and made Panyuan County.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，河決河陰縣，溺死者四十二人。

translations.literal: On renxu, the Yellow River breached at Heyin County; forty-two people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Yellow River breached at Heyin County, and forty-two people drowned.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸新授青州節度使安審琦第。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he visited the residence of the newly appointed military governor of Qingzhou, An Shenqi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he visited the residence of An Shenqi, the newly appointed military governor of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，邢州留後陳思讓奏，破河東賊軍千餘人於西山下，斬首五百級。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Chen Sireng, acting governor of Xingzhou, reported that at the foot of West Mountain he defeated more than a thousand rebel troops from Hedong and took five hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Chen Sireng, acting governor of Xingzhou, reported that at the foot of West Mountain he had defeated more than a thousand rebel troops from Hedong and taken five hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，延州奏，溠溪水漲，壞州城，溺死者百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on gengchen, Yanzhou reported that the Tashi Stream rose, destroying the prefectural city; more than a hundred people drowned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengchen Yanzhou reported that the Tashi Stream rose, destroying the prefectural city; more than a hundred people drowned.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太子太師致仕宋彥筠卒。

translations.literal: On jichou, Song Yanjun, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Song Yanjun, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，江南李景上表乞降，詔書不允。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Li Jing of Jiangnan submitted a memorial begging to surrender; the imperial response did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Jing of Jiangnan submitted a memorial begging to surrender; the imperial response did not grant it.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，以太府卿馮延魯為刑部侍郎，以衛尉少卿鐘謨為給事中，並放歸江南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on dingsi, Feng Yanlu, Minister of the Treasury, was made Vice Minister of Justice; Zhong Mo, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Princes, was made Supervising Secretary; both were released to return to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingsi Feng Yanlu, Minister of the Treasury, was made Vice Minister of Justice, and Zhong Mo, Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Princes, was made Supervising Secretary; both were released to return to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 時延魯、鐘謨自江南復命，李景復奏欲傳位於其世子宏冀，帝亦以書答之。

translations.literal: At that time Feng Yanlu and Zhong Mo returned from Jiangnan on their mission; Li Jing again submitted a memorial wishing to transfer the throne to his heir Hongji, and the Emperor also replied by letter.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Feng Yanlu and Zhong Mo returned from Jiangnan on their mission. Li Jing again submitted a memorial wishing to transfer the throne to his heir Hongji, and the Emperor also replied by letter.

sentences.zh: 甲子，賜江南羊萬口、馬三百匹、橐駝三十頭，賜兩浙錢俶羊五千口、馬二百匹、橐駝二十頭。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Jiangnan was granted ten thousand sheep, three hundred horses, and thirty camels; Qian Chu of the Two Zhes was granted five thousand sheep, two hundred horses, and twenty camels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Jiangnan was granted ten thousand sheep, three hundred horses, and thirty camels, and Qian Chu of the Two Zhes was granted five thousand sheep, two hundred horses, and twenty camels.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜宰臣、樞密使及近臣宴於玉津園。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Chief Ministers, Commissioner of Military Affairs, and close attendants were granted a banquet in the Jade Ford Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Chief Ministers, Commissioner of Military Affairs, and close attendants were granted a banquet in the Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，占城國王釋利因德漫遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jisi, King Indravarman of Champa sent envoys to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi King Indravarman of Champa sent envoys to present local products.

sentences.zh: 壬子，天清節，群臣詣廣德殿上壽。

translations.literal: On renzi, on the Heavenly Clarity Festival, the officials went to the Hall of Broad Virtue to offer birthday congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Heavenly Clarity Festival, the officials went to the Hall of Broad Virtue to offer birthday congratulations.

sentences.zh: 江南進奉使商崇義代李景捧壽觴以獻。

translations.literal: Shang Chongyi, tribute envoy of Jiangnan, presented the birthday cup on Li Jing's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Chongyi, Jiangnan's tribute envoy, presented the birthday cup on Li Jing's behalf.

sentences.zh: （《宋類苑》云：湯悅，父殷舉，唐末有才名。

translations.literal: (From the Song Lei Yuan: Tang Yue — his father Yin Ju passed the examinations; at the end of Tang he had a reputation for talent.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Song Lei Yuan: Tang Yue — his father Yin Ju passed the examinations, and at the end of Tang he had a reputation for talent.

sentences.zh: 本名崇義，建隆初，避宣祖諱改姓湯。

translations.literal: His original name was Chongyi; at the beginning of Jianlong he changed his surname to Tang to avoid the taboo on the Founding Ancestor's name.
translations.idiomatic: His original name was Chongyi; at the beginning of Jianlong he changed his surname to Tang to avoid the taboo on the Founding Ancestor's name.

sentences.zh: 初在吳為舍人，受詔撰揚州《孝先寺碑》，世宗親往，駐蹕此寺，讀其文賞嘆。

translations.literal: At first while in Wu he served as drafting officer; he received an order to compose the stele for Yangzhou's Xiaoxian Temple. Shizong personally went there, halted at this temple, read the text, and praised it.
translations.idiomatic: At first, while serving in Wu as a drafting officer, he received an order to compose the stele for Yangzhou's Xiaoxian Temple. Shizong personally went there, halted at this temple, read the text, and praised it.

sentences.zh: 及畫江議定，後主遣悅入貢，世宗為之加禮。

translations.literal: When the river as border was decided, the Later Lord sent Yue to present tribute; Shizong gave him added honors.
translations.idiomatic: When the river as border was decided, the Later Lord sent Yue to present tribute, and Shizong gave him added honors.

sentences.zh: 自淮上用兵，凡書詔多悅之作，特為典贍，切於事情。

translations.literal: From the time of military action on the Huai, most imperial letters and edicts were Yue's work — particularly canonical and ample, pressing close to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From the time of military action on the Huai, most imperial letters and edicts were Yue's work — particularly canonical and ample, and pressing close to affairs.

sentences.zh: 世宗每覽江南文字，形於嗟嘆。

translations.literal: Whenever Shizong read Jiangnan documents, he sighed aloud.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever Shizong read Jiangnan documents, he sighed aloud.

sentences.zh: 當時沈遇、馬士元皆不稱職，復用陶蒨、李昉於舍人，其後用扈載，率由此也。）〉

translations.literal: At that time Shen Yu and Ma Shiyuan were both unfit for their posts; Tao Qian and Li Fang were again used as drafting officers — afterward Hu Zai was employed, all largely for this reason.)]
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shen Yu and Ma Shiyuan were both unfit for their posts; Tao Qian and Li Fang were again used as drafting officers, and afterward Hu Zai was employed — all largely for this reason.)]

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，以戶部侍郎高防為西南面水陸轉運使，將用師於巴、邛故也。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month on jimao, Gao Fang, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Southwestern land-and-water transport commissioner, because troops were about to be used in Ba and Qiong.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month on jimao Gao Fang, Vice Minister of Revenue, was made Southwestern land-and-water transport commissioner, because troops were about to be deployed in Ba and Qiong.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·高防傳》：世宗謀伐蜀，以防為西南面水陸轉運制置使，屢發芻糧赴鳳州，為征討之備。）〉

translations.literal: (From the Biography of Gao Fang in the Song History: Shizong planned to attack Shu; he appointed Fang Southwestern land-and-water transport and disposition commissioner; he repeatedly dispatched fodder and grain to Fengzhou as preparation for the punitive campaign.)]
translations.idiomatic: (From the Biography of Gao Fang in the Song History: Shizong planned to attack Shu and appointed Fang Southwestern land-and-water transport and disposition commissioner; he repeatedly dispatched fodder and grain to Fengzhou as preparation for the punitive campaign.)]

sentences.zh: 丙戌，邠州李暉移鎮鳳翔。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Li Hui of Binzhou was transferred to garrison Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Li Hui of Binzhou was transferred to garrison Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸迎春苑。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he visited the Welcome Spring Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he visited the Welcome Spring Garden.

sentences.zh: 己丑，太常卿司徒詡以本官致仕。

translations.literal: On jichou, Situ Xu, Minister of Rites, retired from office while retaining his title.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Situ Xu, Minister of Rites, retired from office while retaining his title.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，帝狩於近郊。

translations.literal: On renchen, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，前相州節度使王饒卒。

translations.literal: On guisi, Wang Rao, former military governor of Xiangzhou, died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Wang Rao, former military governor of Xiangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 甲午，左監門上將軍許文縝、右千牛上將軍邊鎬、衛尉卿周延構並歸江南。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Xu Wenzhen, Senior General of the Left Gate Guard; Bian Hao, Senior General of the Right Palace Bull Army; and Zhou Yangou, Minister of the Court of Imperial Princes, all returned to Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Xu Wenzhen, Senior General of the Left Gate Guard; Bian Hao, Senior General of the Right Palace Bull Army; and Zhou Yangou, Minister of the Court of Imperial Princes, all returned to Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔淮南諸州鄉軍，並放歸農。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict ordered that local militia of the Huainan prefectures all be released to return to farming.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict ordered that local militia of the Huainan prefectures all be released to return to farming.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣左散騎常侍艾穎等均定河南六十州稅賦。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Ai Ying, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier Companion for Dispatches, and others were dispatched to equalize taxes and levies in the sixty prefectures of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ai Ying, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalier Companion for Dispatches, and others were dispatched to equalize taxes and levies in the sixty prefectures of Henan.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》載賜諸道均田詔曰：「朕以干戈既弭，寰海漸寧，言念地征，罕臻藝極，須並行均定，所冀永適重輕。

translations.literal: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials, the edict on equal fields to the circuits reads: "Since weapons have been laid down and the realm is gradually at peace, thinking of land taxation which rarely reaches perfection, equal distribution must be carried out together, so that heavy and light burdens may forever suit each other.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Five Dynasties Essentials, the edict on equal fields to the circuits reads: "Since weapons have been laid down and the realm is gradually at peace, thinking of land taxation which rarely reaches perfection, equal distribution must be carried out together, so that heavy and light burdens may forever suit each other.

sentences.zh: 卿受任方隅，深窮治本，必須副寡昧平分之意，察鄉閭治弊之原，明示條章，用分寄任，佇令集事，允屬推公。

translations.literal: You hold office in your region and must thoroughly investigate root remedies; you must fulfill my intent of equal division and ascertain the origins of corruption in your villages, clearly promulgating regulations to divide entrusted responsibility; we wait for affairs to be gathered and completed — this indeed requires impartial promotion.
translations.idiomatic: You hold office in your region and must thoroughly investigate root remedies. You must fulfill my intent of equal division and ascertain the origins of corruption in your villages, clearly promulgating regulations to divide entrusted responsibility. We wait for affairs to be gathered and completed — this indeed requires impartial promotion.

sentences.zh: 今差使臣往彼檢括，餘從別敕。）〉

translations.literal: Now commissioners are sent there to inspect and register; the rest follows separate edicts.")]
translations.idiomatic: Now commissioners are sent there to inspect and register; the rest follows separate edicts.")]

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未朔，詔翰林學士竇儼，集文學之士，撰集《大周通禮》、《大周正樂》，從儼之奏也。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eleventh month, dingwei, an edict ordered Dou Yan, Hanlin academician, to gather men of letters to compile the Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou and the Correct Music of Great Zhou — following Yan's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, dingwei, an edict ordered Dou Yan, Hanlin academician, to gather men of letters to compile the Comprehensive Rites of Great Zhou and the Correct Music of Great Zhou, following Yan's memorial.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，日南至，帝御崇元殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the winter solstice, the Emperor took the throne at the Hall of Grand Origin to receive court congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the winter solstice, the Emperor took the throne at the Hall of Grand Origin to receive court congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.

sentences.zh: 己未，昭義李筠奏，破遼州長清寨，獲偽命磁州刺史李再興。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Jun of Zhaoyi reported that he had broken Changqing Stockade in Liaozhou and captured Li Zaixing, the false-appointed prefect of Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Jun of Zhaoyi reported that he had broken Changqing Stockade in Liaozhou and captured Li Zaixing, the false-appointed prefect of Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，帝狩於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑朔，郎州奏，醴陵縣玉仙觀山門中，舊有田二萬頃，久為山石閉塞，今年七月十七日夜，暴雷劈開，其路復通。

translations.literal: On the first day of the twelfth month, dingchou, Langzhou reported that within the mountain gate of Yuxian Abbey in Liling County there had formerly been twenty thousand qing of fields, long blocked by rock; on the night of the seventeenth day of the seventh month this year, a violent thunderbolt split them open and the path was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, dingchou, Langzhou reported that within the mountain gate of Yuxian Abbey in Liling County there had formerly been twenty thousand qing of fields, long blocked by rock. On the night of the seventeenth day of the seventh month this year, a violent thunderbolt split them open and the path was restored.

sentences.zh: 己卯，楚州兵馬都監武懷恩棄市，坐擅殺降軍四人也。

translations.literal: On jimao, Wu Huai'en, military supervisor of Chuzhou, was executed in the marketplace for having on his own authority killed four surrendered soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Wu Huai'en, military supervisor of Chuzhou, was executed in the marketplace for having on his own authority killed four surrendered soldiers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔重定諸道州府幕職令錄佐官料錢，其州縣官俸戶宜停。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict ordered a redetermination of the salary stipends for staff secretaries, county recorders, and assistant officials in the prefectures and districts of every circuit; the practice of salary households for prefectural and county officials should be discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict ordered a redetermination of the salary stipends for staff secretaries, county recorders, and assistant officials in the prefectures and districts of every circuit; the practice of salary households for prefectural and county officials should be discontinued.

sentences.zh: 己丑，楚州防禦使張順賜死，坐在任隱落榷稅錢五十萬、官絲綿二千兩也。

translations.literal: On jichou, Zhang Shun, defense commissioner of Chuzhou, was granted death by suicide for having while in office concealed and embezzled five hundred thousand in monopoly tax money and two thousand ounces of official silk and cotton.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Zhang Shun, defense commissioner of Chuzhou, was granted death by suicide for having while in office concealed and embezzled five hundred thousand in monopoly tax money and two thousand ounces of official silk and cotton.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔兩京及五府少尹司參軍各省一員，六曹判司內只直戶法二曹，余及諸州觀察支使、兩蕃判官並省。

translations.literal: On renchen, an edict ordered that in the Two Capitals and the Five Prefectures one Junior Assistant and one Legal Assistant each be reduced; within the six bureaus only the Household and Justice sections were to remain; the rest, along with observation envoys of the various prefectures and border commissioners, were all to be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen an edict ordered that in the Two Capitals and the Five Prefectures one Junior Assistant and one Legal Assistant each be reduced; within the six bureaus only the Household and Justice sections were to remain; the rest, along with observation envoys of the various prefectures and border commissioners, were all to be reduced.

sentences.zh: 甲午，帝狩於近郊。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鄧州劉重進移鎮邠州，滑州宋延渥移鎮鄧州，以前河中節度使王仁鎬為邢州節度使，以邢州留後陳思讓為滑州留後。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Liu Chongjin of Dengzhou was transferred to garrison Binzhou; Song Yanwo of Huazhou was transferred to garrison Dengzhou; Wang Renhao, former military governor of Hezhong, was made military governor of Xingzhou; and Chen Sireng, acting governor of Xingzhou, was made acting governor of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Liu Chongjin of Dengzhou was transferred to garrison Binzhou; Song Yanwo of Huazhou was transferred to garrison Dengzhou; Wang Renhao, former military governor of Hezhong, was made military governor of Xingzhou; and Chen Sireng, acting governor of Xingzhou, was made acting governor of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔翰林學士，今後逐日起居，當直者仍赴晚朝。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict ordered that Hanlin academicians from now on attend daily court; those on duty were still to attend the evening audience.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an edict ordered that Hanlin academicians from now on attend daily court, and those on duty were still to attend the evening audience.

sentences.zh: 是月，江南李景殺其臣偽太傅中書令宋齊丘、偽兵部侍郎陳覺、偽鎮南軍節度副使李徵古等。

translations.literal: That month Li Jing of Jiangnan executed his ministers: the false-appointed Grand Mentor and Director of the Chancellery Song Qiqiu, the false-appointed Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, the false-appointed deputy military governor of the Zhennan Army Li Zhenggu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Jing of Jiangnan executed his ministers: the false-appointed Grand Mentor and Director of the Chancellery Song Qiqiu, the false-appointed Vice Minister of War Chen Jue, the false-appointed deputy military governor of the Zhennan Army Li Zhenggu, and others.

sentences.zh: 初，帝之南征也，吳人大懼，覺與徵古皆齊丘門人，因進說於景，請委國事於齊丘，景繇是銜之。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Emperor marched south, the people of Wu were greatly afraid; Chen Jue and Li Zhenggu were both disciples of Song Qiqiu and therefore advised Li Jing to entrust state affairs to Qiqiu — for this Li Jing bore a grudge against them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Emperor marched south, the people of Wu were greatly afraid. Chen Jue and Li Zhenggu were both disciples of Song Qiqiu and therefore advised Li Jing to entrust state affairs to Qiqiu — for this Li Jing bore a grudge against them.

sentences.zh: 及吳人遣鐘謨、李德明奉表至行在，帝尋遣德明復命於金陵，德明因說李景請割江南之地求和於我，而陳覺、李徵古等以德明為賣國，請戮之，景遂殺德明。

translations.literal: When the people of Wu sent Zhong Mo and Li Deming to present a memorial at the mobile headquarters, the Emperor soon sent Deming back on mission to Jinling; Deming then advised Li Jing to cede Jiangnan territory and seek peace with us, but Chen Jue, Li Zhenggu, and others regarded Deming as a traitor to the country and asked that he be executed; Li Jing then killed Deming.
translations.idiomatic: When the people of Wu sent Zhong Mo and Li Deming to present a memorial at the mobile headquarters, the Emperor soon sent Deming back on mission to Jinling. Deming then advised Li Jing to cede Jiangnan territory and seek peace with us, but Chen Jue, Li Zhenggu, and others regarded Deming as a traitor to the country and asked that he be executed; Li Jing then killed Deming.

sentences.zh: 及江南內附，帝放鐘謨南歸，謨本德明之黨也，因譖齊丘等，故齊丘等得罪。

translations.literal: When Jiangnan submitted internally, the Emperor released Zhong Mo to return south; Mo had originally been of Deming's faction and therefore slandered Qiqiu and the others, and for this Qiqiu and the others fell into disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiangnan submitted, the Emperor released Zhong Mo to return south. Mo had been an associate of Deming and slandered Qiqiu and the others, and for this Qiqiu and his circle fell into disgrace.

sentences.zh: 放齊丘歸九華山，覺等貶官，尋並害之。

translations.literal: Qiqiu was released to return to Mount Jiuhua; Jue and the others were demoted in office, and soon all were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Qiqiu was sent back to Mount Jiuhua; Jue and the others were demoted, and soon all were killed.

sentences.zh: 景既誅齊丘等，令鐘謨到闕，具言其事，故書。

translations.literal: After Li Jing had executed Qiqiu and the others, he ordered Zhong Mo to come to court and set forth the matter in full — hence this record.
translations.idiomatic: After Li Jing had executed Qiqiu and the others, he had Zhong Mo come to court and report the affair in full — hence this account.
